cases.question: How can I change the word 'company' to 'startup' everywhere on my site?
cases.expected_answer: Use Text Labels: go to Settings » Text Labels, type the word in the Search box, change the label's text, then click Save in the Unsaved changes bar. One change updates the word everywhere it appears.
cases.notes: Example case: keep it, edit it or replace it.

history.content: How do I change the word 'company' everywhere on my site?
Go to Settings » Text Labels, find the label and change its text.

cases.question: Can I see only the ones I changed last week?
cases.expected_answer: Yes: click the Date edited field above the list, choose the Last 7 Days preset (or a start and an end date) in its calendar, then click Apply. Sorting by Recently Edited also puts the latest changes first.
cases.notes: Example case: the question only makes sense with the history.

cases.question: What is the phone number of your sales office in Berlin?
cases.notes: Example case. 'Berlin' appears only as a sample city in the Users API article, so search finds that article; the answer must still be 'I don't know'.
